scope: Device-specific clean prebuilt distribution from existing PVE-reference-patched ARM64 ReDroid13 outputs; core first, optional part2 separate; not a full source rebuild.

profile.pve_reference: hqw700/redroid-pve v0.0.4; actual exported AOSP patches in this repository
profile.userdata: empty; generated independently on first boot
profile.zygisk_next_lsposed: not preinstalled; no module license or authorization data included
profile.network: UID broker required; empty app selection; optional proxy disabled by default
profile.management: 1.2.1; runtime address-aware controllers; label derived from actual eth0 IPv4; proxy disabled; broker starts with an empty app selection
profile.hardware_codec: current-ROM QTI libraries, stock scrcpy default linear format patch
profile.capabilities: nocaps + allow_sandboxing=1 + original cap-init drops five capabilities; not rootless

image.validation: pristine filesystem and recorded core hashes; runtime results recorded separately

inputs.magisk_input_kind: historical unofficial; exact corresponding source not established

optional_modules.name: Zygisk Next
optional_modules.provenance: Downloaded ZIP hash matches official GitHub release asset digest; rehosting excluded.

optional_modules.name: LSPosed
optional_modules.provenance: Provider download and metadata matched the original tested ZIP on 2026-11-28. URL is mutable; reject any different hash. No independent source authentication is asserted; no ZIP/license is rehosted.

validation.pristine_filesystem: PASS e2fsck -fn; new ext4, data/cache/metadata/dev/proc/run/sys/tmp empty, core hashes matched, xattrs restored
validation.device_copy_raw_hash: PASS before first boot, identical to pristine image
validation.first_boot: PASS boot_completed/modules_ready/terminal_ready/release.ready all 1; own address config, empty broker selection, proxy disabled
validation.module_cold_boot: PASS Next1.5.3(880) inject_state1, modules_with_issue0; LSPosed2.2.1(7912) API102 daemonRunning/systemServerRequested true, safeMode false, installedModules0
validation.callbacks: PASS genuine pre/post app and system_server callbacks; no third-party Xposed business hook asserted
validation.negative_identity_and_fd: PASS three rejected peer cases, genuine setcon denial preserved, actual SCM_RIGHTS transfer with child exit0
validation.magisk_frontend: PASS actual Modules page with enabled LSPosed and callback probe, install-from-storage present
validation.ordinary_app: PASS source-backed ordinary UID APK: private file I/O, SharedMemory, DNS, HTTPS200 with default TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
validation.terminal: PASS actual Droidspaces interactive PTY on preceding release-initialization candidate, uid0 /dev/pts/0; final image terminal_ready1 with same terminal files
validation.memory_limit: PASS actual cgroupv1 limit2684354560 bytes on release candidate, failcnt0
validation.native_build: PASS NDKr29; existing unused-parameter warning retained
validation.local_transport_tests: PASS five proxy transport cases, four auth cases, sparse gzip creation/corruption/non-overwrite checks
validation.restore_original: PASS original rootfs/config restored and running; original Next injection and LSPosed system_server rechecked; script app enabled and closed
